compatible_changes: add a finite fixture without changing an operation meaning or signature
add a consumer that uses only an existing operation and declares a separate authority boundary
clarify non-normative documentation without changing declared semantics
breaking_changes: change an operation name, input shape, output shape, or execution order
change Unicode normalization, lowercase, separator, token-boundary, or phrase-boundary semantics
make reason accumulation normalize, reorder, or duplicate reason text
move consumer-specific policy into the shared semantic contract
change the selector or authority posture
required_on_any_byte_change: recompile the declared Alch source through ontology and Craft
refresh exact source and runtime digests
rerun semantic fixtures and cross-consumer parity
rerun every declared consumer regression suite
issue a fresh governance evidence and owner review candidate
open_questions: What compatibility window, if any, should an admitted service transport support?
